title: Example Explainer: script and pictures
heading: A short explainer of your subject
lede: Every word the narrator will say, beside a still of each scene once its picture has finished building. Next comes the playable piece (Stop 3).
changed: the plan from Stop 1 is now written as spoken lines, about two minutes long, and drawn.
ask: Do the words and the pictures say it right? Is there a line or a picture you would change?
intro: Beside each picture are the words the narrator speaks over it. Each picture shows its scene once it has finished building. Select a picture to enlarge it, and select it again to shrink it. On a phone, an enlarged picture scrolls sideways.
guesses_ask: Still guessing from Stop 1. Are these right?

guesses.guess: each still-unconfirmed answer, as a guess they can correct

replies: "Go on": I record the narration, animate the scenes to it, and bring you the playable piece (Stop 3).
Change the wording of any line, or any picture.
